event_records.description: Aldergate Rail is aware of the signaling-contract delay and is considering whether to warn the market before the interim results day.

aldergate_rail.name: Aldergate Rail
aldergate_rail.persona_brief:
You are Aldergate Rail.
Aldergate Rail is aware of a delay in its signaling contract. It has not yet decided whether to issue a market warning before its scheduled interim results day on November 5. The firm considers its obligations under market disclosure rules and the potential impact on its reputation and share price.

resolution.question: Will the listed firm Aldergate Rail warn the market about its signaling-contract delay before its scheduled interim results day on November 5?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Aldergate Rail issued a market warning about the signaling-contract delay before 2026-11-05T07:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
